breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复

Association with tetralogy of Fallot, horse-shoe kidneys and diaphragm and lung lobulation defects is reported.

master.definition_en: Simple (monoclonal) cryoglobulinemia or type I cryoglobulinemia refers to the presence in the serum of one isotype or subclass of immunoglobulin (Ig) that precipitates reversibly below 37°C.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

master.definition_en: A rare multiple congenital anomalies/dysmorphic syndrome characterized by non-specific or central hypotonia, Moebius sequence (bilateral congenital facial palsy with impairment of ocular abduction), Pierre-Robin sequence (micrognathia, glossoptosis, and high-arched or cleft palate), congenital myopathy, developmental delay and failure to thrive. Intellectual disability have also been reported in some patients. Variable clinical features may include macro/micro or plagiacephaly, facial dysmorphism, brain anomalies, septal defects, respiratory insufficiency, gastrointestinal problems including poor/absent swallowing, joint contactures, tapering fingers, clubfoot and scoliosis.

master.name_en: neurodevelopmental disorder with hypotonia and variable intellectual and behavioral abnormalities
master.definition_en: Neurodevelopmental disorder in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the POLR2A gene; it is characterized by early-onset hypotonia, delayed walking, poor speech, and impaired intellectual development. Other features may include feeding difficulties, dysmorphic features, and visual problems. Brain magnetic resonance imaging tends to show delayed myelination, thin corpus callosum, and/or enlarged ventricles.

master.definition_en: A benign, borderline, or malignant epithelial tumor of the ovary characterized by the presence of neoplastic epithelial cells that, in well differentiated tumors, resemble the epithelial cells of the fallopian tube and, in poorly differentiated tumors, show anaplastic features. Approximately thirty to fifty percent of the tumors are bilateral. Grossly, the better differentiated tumors consist of cystic masses, usually unilocular, containing a clear but sometimes viscous fluid. Papillary formations are often present. The more malignant tumors tend to be solid and invasive, with areas of necrosis and hemorrhage.
